text: Sample content. On a live site these are the housekeeping facts an editor keeps up to date; the dates and names below are invented and describe nothing that was actually reviewed.
note: Nothing here is read from the record's timestamp. That is deliberate: a timestamp changes when a typo is corrected, whereas this line is meant to say when a human last read the page and decided it was still right.
